item.text: I’ve inspected the schema. The cleanup needs to remove YouTube URL rows plus their visit records, search-term links, history clusters, segments, and visited-link cache rows so they do not keep showing up in Chrome history suggestions.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os, shutil, sqlite3, time
p = '/home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default/History'
backup = f'{p}.backup-before-youtube-delete-{time.strftime(\"%Y%m%d-%H%M%S\")}'
shutil.copy2(p, backup)
con = sqlite3.connect(p)
cur = con.cursor()
cur.execute('PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF')
patterns = [
    '%youtube.com%',
    '%youtu.be%',
    '%youtube-nocookie.com%',
]
where_url = ' OR '.join(['lower(url) LIKE ?' for _ in patterns])
params = patterns
url_count_before = cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM urls WHERE {where_url}', params).fetchone()[0]
visit_count_before = cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE url IN (SELECT id FROM urls WHERE {where_url})', params).fetchone()[0]
cur.execute('BEGIN')
cur.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE youtube_url_ids(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)')
cur.execute(f'INSERT INTO youtube_url_ids SELECT id FROM urls WHERE {where_url}', params)
cur.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE youtube_visit_ids(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)')
cur.execute('INSERT INTO youtube_visit_ids SELECT id FROM visits WHERE url IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_url_ids)')
cur.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE affected_cluster_ids(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)')
cur.execute('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO affected_cluster_ids SELECT cluster_id FROM clusters_and_visits WHERE visit_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids)')
cur.execute('CREATE TEMP TABLE youtube_segment_ids(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)')
cur.execute('INSERT INTO youtube_segment_ids SELECT id FROM segments WHERE url_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_url_ids)')

# Remove records that point at the visits/URLs being deleted.
cur.execute('DELETE FROM cluster_visit_duplicates WHERE visit_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids) OR duplicate_visit_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM clusters_and_visits WHERE visit_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM content_annotations WHERE visit_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM context_annotations WHERE visit_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM visit_source WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM keyword_search_terms WHERE url_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_url_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM segment_usage WHERE segment_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_segment_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM segments WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_segment_ids)')
cur.execute(\"DELETE FROM visited_links WHERE link_url_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_url_ids) OR lower(top_level_url) LIKE '%youtube.com%' OR lower(top_level_url) LIKE '%youtu.be%' OR lower(top_level_url) LIKE '%youtube-nocookie.com%' OR lower(frame_url) LIKE '%youtube.com%' OR lower(frame_url) LIKE '%youtu.be%' OR lower(frame_url) LIKE '%youtube-nocookie.com%'\")

# Remove downloads history entries that are clearly tied to YouTube URLs, without touching downloaded files.
cur.execute(\"CREATE TEMP TABLE youtube_download_ids(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)\")
cur.execute(\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO youtube_download_ids SELECT id FROM downloads_url_chains WHERE lower(url) LIKE '%youtube.com%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%youtu.be%' OR lower(url) LIKE '%youtube-nocookie.com%'\")
cur.execute(\"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO youtube_download_ids SELECT id FROM downloads WHERE lower(referrer) LIKE '%youtube.com%' OR lower(referrer) LIKE '%youtu.be%' OR lower(referrer) LIKE '%youtube-nocookie.com%' OR lower(site_url) LIKE '%youtube.com%' OR lower(site_url) LIKE '%youtu.be%' OR lower(site_url) LIKE '%youtube-nocookie.com%' OR lower(tab_url) LIKE '%youtube.com%' OR lower(tab_url) LIKE '%youtu.be%' OR lower(tab_url) LIKE '%youtube-nocookie.com%' OR lower(tab_referrer_url) LIKE '%youtube.com%' OR lower(tab_referrer_url) LIKE '%youtu.be%' OR lower(tab_referrer_url) LIKE '%youtube-nocookie.com%'\")
cur.execute('DELETE FROM downloads_url_chains WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_download_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM downloads_slices WHERE download_id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_download_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM downloads WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_download_ids)')

cur.execute('DELETE FROM visits WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_visit_ids)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM urls WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM youtube_url_ids)')

# Clean clusters made empty by the deletion.
cur.execute('DELETE FROM cluster_keywords WHERE cluster_id IN (SELECT id FROM affected_cluster_ids) AND cluster_id NOT IN (SELECT cluster_id FROM clusters_and_visits)')
cur.execute('DELETE FROM clusters WHERE cluster_id IN (SELECT id FROM affected_cluster_ids) AND cluster_id NOT IN (SELECT cluster_id FROM clusters_and_visits)')
con.commit()
remaining_urls = cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM urls WHERE {where_url}', params).fetchone()[0]
remaining_visits = cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits WHERE url IN (SELECT id FROM urls WHERE {where_url})', params).fetchone()[0]
cur.execute('VACUUM')
con.close()
print(f'Backup: {backup}')
print(f'YouTube URL rows removed: {url_count_before - remaining_urls} of {url_count_before}')
print(f'YouTube visit rows removed: {visit_count_before - remaining_visits} of {visit_count_before}')
print(f'Remaining YouTube URL rows in urls table: {remaining_urls}')
print(f'Remaining YouTube visit rows: {remaining_visits}')
PY"
